chunks: about a man who arrives as a pilgrim, and the heat has become intense upon him, so he performs tawaf around the Kaʿbah and delays the saʿy until it becomes cooler.
So he said: “There is no harm in it, and I have sometimes done it.”

key_terms.بِٱلْكَعْبَةِ: around the Kaʿbah, the sacred sanctuary
key_terms.حَاجًّا: a person in the state of pilgrimage for hajj
key_terms.فَعَلْتُهُ: I did it, indicating the Imam’s own practice
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf, circling the Kaʿbah
key_terms.ٱلسَّعْيَ: the ritual saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the saʿy after tawaf in Hajj because of severe heat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a pilgrim is severely affected by the heat, he may perform tawaf first and delay the saʿy until the weather cools. The Imam عليه السلام declares this permissible and mentions that he himself had sometimes done so, indicating practical allowance in such circumstances.
